bio: Here in the restaurant of Das Achental hotel, Edip Sigl impresses diners with his distinctive culinary style. His dishes are modern, sophisticated and packed with flavour and intense contrasts. However, they always remain wonderfully balanced. For example, the fantastic Mieral pigeon is given a nice barbecued note with a roasted finish and served with a harmonious onion and beetroot filling in a crispy baked tart and slices of intense-flavoured Périgord truffle. Diners choose from two set menus comprising six or eight courses dubbed Chiemgau pur and Chiemgau goes around the world. As the names suggest, the first is dedicated entirely to premium produce from the Chiemgau region, while the second combines local and international ingredients.
